run_f_gold: run f_gold to rearrange a sorted array in maximum minimum alternating form
test_f_gold: test f_gold against filled function using the provided parameter sets
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that alternates max and min elements in an array
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to support unsorted input arrays with O(n log n) sorting
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that rearranges array elements in max min form
